number_content_base.name: uses
number_content_base.script:
function onDoubleClick() -- add some logic for grenades: sync inventory uses/carried with weapon uses checkGrenade();
-- then we call the outer reload action to do the normal behavior local sDBnode = window.getDatabaseNode(); if not sDBnode then if WindowManager and WindowManager.callOuterWindowFunction then WindowManager.callOuterWindowFunction(window, "onReloadAction") end return end end
-- grenade handling function checkGrenade() -- determine subtype local sDBnode = window.getDatabaseNode(); local sSubtype = DB.getValue(sDBnode, "subtype", "") Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick subtype=" .. tostring(sSubtype));
if not (sSubtype == "grenade" or sSubtype == "Grenade") then -- not a grenade, return so it can continue as before return; end
-- debug the path using hard coded test nodes Debug.console("sDBnode path: " .. sDBnode.getPath());
-- testing the solution local sWeapName = DB.getValue(sDBnode, "name", ""); Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick weapon name: " .. tostring(sWeapName)); local sClass, sRecordName = DB.getValue(sDBnode, "shortcut"); local vInvNode = DB.findNode(sRecordName); Debug.console("linked inventory node: " .. tostring(vInvNode and vInvNode.getPath() or "nil")); local nCount = DB.getValue(vInvNode, "count", 0); Debug.console("(linked inventory) test inventory count: " .. tostring(nCount) ); -- testing complete
-- grenade: find linked inventory node -- safer read: attempt to read the nested shortcut child first, then fall back local shortcutNode = DB.getChild(sDBnode, "shortcut") local sRecordName = "" if shortcutNode then sRecordName = DB.getText(shortcutNode, "recordname", "") Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick shortcut node found: " .. tostring(shortcutNode.getPath())) else Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick shortcut node NOT found; trying fallback") -- fallback attempt (some DB shims may expose dotted fields differently) sRecordName = DB.getText(sDBnode, "shortcut.recordname", "") end Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick shortcut.recordname=" .. tostring(sRecordName)) local nodeInv = nil if sRecordName ~= "" then nodeInv = DB.findNode(sRecordName) end
-- if not found, try resolving relative (leading dots) against weapon path if (not nodeInv) and sRecordName ~= "" then -- count leading dots local dotCount = 0 for i = 1, #sRecordName do if sRecordName:sub(i,i) == '.' then dotCount = dotCount + 1 else break end end Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick: leading dots=" .. tostring(dotCount)) if sf.isGt(dotCount, 0) then local sSuffix = sRecordName:sub(dotCount + 1) local sWeaponPath = "" if sDBnode.getPath then sWeaponPath = sDBnode.getPath() end Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick weaponPath=" .. tostring(sWeaponPath))
-- split weapon path into components and walk up dotCount parents local parts = {} for part in sWeaponPath:gmatch('[^%.]+') do table.insert(parts, part) end Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick weaponPath parts=" .. tostring(#parts)) if sf.isGt(#parts, 0) then local up = dotCount if sf.isGt(up, #parts) then up = #parts end for i = 1, up do table.remove(parts) end local sBase = table.concat(parts, '.') if sBase and sBase ~= '' and sSuffix and sSuffix ~= '' then local sCandidate = sBase .. '.' .. sSuffix Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick trying candidate=" .. tostring(sCandidate)) nodeInv = DB.findNode(sCandidate) end end end end
if not nodeInv then Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick: no linked inventory found") if WindowManager and WindowManager.callOuterWindowFunction then WindowManager.callOuterWindowFunction(window, "onReloadAction") end return end
-- get inventory count: prefer carried, fall back to uses local nInvCarried = DB.getValue(nodeInv, "carried", nil) local nInvUses = DB.getValue(nodeInv, "uses", nil) Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick nodeInv.carried=" .. tostring(nInvCarried) .. ", uses=" .. tostring(nInvUses)) local nInvCount = 0 if nInvCarried ~= nil then nInvCount = nInvCarried else if nInvUses ~= nil then nInvCount = nInvUses end end
-- read current ammo (shots fired). If zero, just sync Uses to inventory and reload. local nAmmo = DB.getValue(sDBnode, "ammo", 0) Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick current ammo=" .. tostring(nAmmo) .. ", invCount=" .. tostring(nInvCount))
if nAmmo == 0 then -- sync uses to inventory DB.setValue(sDBnode, "uses", "number", nInvCount) Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick synced uses to " .. tostring(nInvCount)) if WindowManager and WindowManager.callOuterWindowFunction then WindowManager.callOuterWindowFunction(window, "onReloadAction") end return end
-- ammo gt 0: consume that many from inventory (or at least 1). Compute new inventory count. local nToConsume = tonumber(nAmmo) or 0 local nNewInv = math.max(nInvCount - nToConsume, 0) Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick consuming " .. tostring(nToConsume) .. ", newInv=" .. tostring(nNewInv))
if DB.getValue(nodeInv, "carried", nil) ~= nil then DB.setValue(nodeInv, "carried", "number", nNewInv) else DB.setValue(nodeInv, "uses", "number", nNewInv) end
-- update weapon uses and let the outer reload clear ammo DB.setValue(sDBnode, "uses", "number", nNewInv) Debug.console("uses:onDoubleClick set weapon uses to " .. tostring(nNewInv) .. ", calling outer reload") if WindowManager and WindowManager.callOuterWindowFunction then WindowManager.callOuterWindowFunction(window, "onReloadAction") end end
